snippet.title: GB Studio製の自作ゲーム『持ち物がいっぱいです』紹介動画『Inventory Full』Promotional video for my original game.
snippet.description:
ブラウザ・スマホ・Analogue Pocket等で遊べるフリーゲームです。
😝仲間の持ち物を奪ってフリマアプリで売る！？　呪いの人形を出品すると…👻
GB Studio製のゲームボーイ風ミニアクションです。最短3分ほどでクリアできるのでお気軽にプレイしてみてください！実況も歓迎！

🎮Game play　https://megamittz.com/game/motidesu/index.html

This is a free game you can play on your browser, smartphone, or Analogue Pocket.
😝 Steal your party members' items and sell them on a flea market app!? What happens if you list a cursed doll... 👻
A mini Game Boy-style action game made with GB Studio. You can clear it in as little as 3 minutes, so feel free to give it a try! Streaming is also welcome!
